join.a: Click here to join OneToken — it's free and easy to get started. Sign in or create a Travu account, then tap Join for free on this page.

howItWorks.q: How does the OneToken rewards program work?
howItWorks.a: OneToken is our rewards program where members enjoy Member Prices and earn OneTokenCash on eligible bookings. $1 in OneTokenCash equals $1 to use on Travel. As you book travel you collect trip elements that move you up the tiers — Blue, Silver, Gold, and Platinum.

expire.a: OneTokenCash earned on bookings won't expire if you make an eligible booking at least once within 18 months.

flights.q: Can I use OneTokenCash on flights?
flights.a: Yes. OneTokenCash can be redeemed at checkout on eligible flight and stay bookings, applied as an instant discount on the amount due.

tierStatus.q: How do I reach tier status with OneToken?
tierStatus.a: You earn one trip element for each hotel room night, vacation rental night, flight ticket, car rental day, cruise cabin night, and activity ticket you book. Collect 5 to unlock Silver, 15 for Gold, and 30 for Platinum.

free.a: Yes — joining OneToken is completely free.
